metadata.approval: Official logo approved by client 2026-11-12; brand approval does not imply pricing/localization approval
notes: All 26 semantic colors are Figma variable aliases resolved against 45 primitive colors.
All 45 primitives, 26 light/dark semantics, 11 spacings and 7 radii were retrieved.
Colors are hexadecimal RGB at alpha=1. The scrim tokens are base RGB colors; overlay opacity must be defined in component contexts, not guessed.
Figma fonts use Inter, but no font binaries are included in this pack.
Exact appearance SVG embeds original raster; approved editable SVG is not pixel-identical.
